messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: `prompt-router:canary` -> 3% traffic in us-west-2 started at 2026-03-22T02:12:01Z

deploy-bot: Quick metric spike detected: prod.p95.latency and prod.prompt-router.5xx_rate increased within 45s. Alert firing: prompt-router-canary-errors > 2%

emily: paging PD and oncall — I have the page. seeing truncated outputs and 502s in traces for a small customer subset in us-west-2. @raj @sara can you eyeball? :rotating_light:

sara: jumping in 527 pulling up live traces. grouped errors show repeated kv_cache_miss -> backend handshake failures. also seeing TLS timeouts to model-backend.

raj: checking rollout annotation and gateway routes. canary traffic assignment looks correct. queries show requests are being routed to prompt-router:v2 pods for the canary subset.

mike: looking at runtime logs on the v2 pods: there's a new attention-kernel path that triggers on quantized models; seeing segfault-retries and fallback thrash. suspect kernel/quantization mismatch.

alice-cs: support note: two paid customers raised incidents with screenshots of truncated responses and HTTP 502s. I've opened support tickets and notified their CSMs.

emily: priority now: minimize customer impact. can we flip a flag to route back to v1 rather than full rollback? want minimal churn.

raj: we have the gateway FF `ff_prompt_routing_v2` targeting prod/us-west-2. flipping it off now. executing: `redwood ff set ff_prompt_routing_v2 false --env prod --region us-west-2`

raj: (cmd) ```
$ redwood ff set ff_prompt_routing_v2 false --env prod --region us-west-2
> success: flag updated
```

deploy-bot: Feature flag change applied: `ff_prompt_routing_v2=false` in prod/us-west-2. Routing falling back to prompt-router:v1 for affected routes.

sara: live traces show traffic draining from v2 -> v1. error-rate trending down; p95 still elevated due to in-flight latency but errors dropping to baseline. :white_check_mark:

alice-cs: telling customers mitigation is live and we're investigating root cause. asking about any data exposure.

sara: confirmed: failures caused request truncation or errors, no successful token exfiltration. no PII detected in logs. adding to incident notes.

mike: recommending we also scale the canary down to eliminate noisy retries: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy prompt-router-canary --replicas=0`. I'll run it.

mike: (cmd) ```
bash$ kubectl -n prod scale deploy prompt-router-canary --replicas=0
# scaled
```

sara: verified no v2 pods remain in us-west-2. metrics returning to normal across the board.

emily: creating incident record and summary for PD and docs. short summary: canary triggered runtime kernel mismatch with quantized models -> increased errors and truncation; mitigation = FF kill-switch + scale down canary; customers notified; no data leakage.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0322-02 created  Priority: P1. Owner: emily. Links: https://pd.redwood.example/INC-2026-0322-02. Channels: #incidents, #eng-runtime.

raj: adding an immediate temporary deploy block to prevent other canaries for this service until review. creating gate `canary_block/prompt-router/runtime-compat-check` with TTL 2026-03-22T12:00:00Z.

raj: ```yaml
canary_block:
  service: prompt-router
  reason: runtime-kernel-quant-mismatch
  until: 2026-03-22T12:00:00Z
```

mike: starting local repro with the exact quant profile and kernel flags. planning MR to add a runtime safety check when selecting kernels for quantized models. MR: https://git.redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/128

emily: oncall todo list: 1) collect 10 representative trace IDs and logs, 2) coordinate with eng-runtime on a compatibility guard, 3) run a controlled staging validation disabling the new kernel path, 4) prepare a customer-facing timeline.

raj: running a sandbox canary with legacy kernel path and quant-disable flag to validate. will post results here by EOD.

emily: handing off monitoring & comms to night oncall @sara. I'll retain incident ownership for RCA until we have a draft.

sara: acknowledged. I'll keep watch overnight and escalate if any regression. leaving notes for morning triage.

alice-cs: status page updated: "Partial degradation of prompt routing in us-west-2 affecting a small set of customers; mitigation applied." Will update when RCA/PMO ready.

emily: TL;DR for postmortem scaffold: hypothesis = kernel optimization on v2 incompatible with quantized execution; mitigation = FF flip & canary scale-down; impact = truncated responses/5xx for subset of customers; next steps = runtime guard, canary block, staging validation, customer timeline, postmortem.

sara: created postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/pmo/incidents/INC-2026-0322-02.md — will flesh when logs + traces collected.

mike: repro confirmed; pushed a guard that detects quant-profile and prohibits legacy-incompatible kernel; will run CI and then stage canary.

raj: note: don't reopen the canary in prod until eng-runtime + eng-sre sign off on cross-region tests.

emily: closing active page. ping me directly if any flare-ups. thanks all for the fast response. :heart:
